description: Opens a pull request when a chart that Argo CD deploys, an image pinned by hand in this repository, K3s or Cilium has a newer version.
Dependabot already covers pip, GitHub Actions and Docker files.

Nothing merges by itself. Longhorn is not here: deploy.sh installs it and its version is held on purpose. The Traefik image pin in apps/traefik/values.yaml is not here either: it is temporary and comes out when the chart catches up.

customManagers.description: Helm charts: repoURL, chart and targetRevision on consecutive lines
The snapshot controller, deployed from a tag of its git repository
Images pinned in this repository's own charts and in Helm values (image: repo:tag)
Velero server image: repository and tag on consecutive lines
K3s version the Ansible playbook installs
Cilium version recorded in the Ansible variables (rolled out by hand with helm upgrade)

packageRules.description: Pinned images and K3s are checked daily, so security releases are not held for a week; charts stay on Monday
Kyverno and its policies chart are released together
Major versions get their own pull request and a label
Images in this repository's own charts: merging deploys the new image. Back up apps that hold data first.
prBodyNotes: Merging deploys this image through Argo CD. For Vaultwarden or Trilium, check the latest backup first: recovery/restore.sh --plan <app>.

packageRules.description: Velero images: the plugin must be tested after every change
prBodyNotes: Run scripts/test-velero-backup.sh after this deploys. Never velero-plugin-for-aws v1.14.2 (velero-io/velero#9951).

packageRules.description: K3s: merging only changes the version; maintain-cluster.sh does the upgrade, one minor version at a time. Held at 1.36 until Cilium supports 1.37 (Cilium 1.20 is tested with Kubernetes 1.33-1.36; 1.37 support comes in Cilium 1.21). Upgrade Cilium first, then lift this.
prBodyNotes: Merging does not upgrade the cluster. Read the K3s release notes, merge, then run ./maintain-cluster.sh (check mode) and ./maintain-cluster.sh --apply to roll it out one node at a time (docs/maintenance.md). Upgrade one minor version at a time.

packageRules.description: Cilium: merging only records the version; the upgrade is a helm upgrade by hand (docs/observability.md). Upgrade Cilium before K3s.
prBodyNotes: Merging does not upgrade Cilium. Read the release notes, then run `helm upgrade cilium cilium --repo https://helm.cilium.io --version <new version without v> -n kube-system --reuse-values` (never `cilium upgrade`: it would move the API port to 6443; see docs/observability.md), watch the agents roll, and merge. Before a K3s minor upgrade, Cilium must list that Kubernetes version as supported.
